## Featured program: The Weslaco Launch Package (grant-funded websites)

Triggers Media runs a program for small businesses in Weslaco, Texas: a professional one-page website for **$0 out of pocket**, paid in full by the **City of Weslaco EDC Business Marketing Grant**.

**How it works.** The Weslaco Economic Development Corporation's Business Marketing Grant covers eligible businesses up to $1,000 for new marketing — including website design, photography, and video. The EDC pays Triggers Media directly, so the business never writes a check. The full price of the package is $1,000, exactly what the grant covers.

**What's included in the $1,000 package:**
- **1-hour on-site onboarding** — one visit; we interview you and capture the photos for your site. You prepare nothing.
- **A one-page professional website** — mobile-first and built to convert: your story, services, photos, hours, map, and a tap-to-call button.
- **Google Business Profile connection** — we link the new site to your Google listing so customers already searching for you have somewhere to land.
- **A Launch Guide** — a plain-English playbook, plus the before/after Google numbers the EDC asks for. We handle the paperwork.
- **One round of edits** before launch.

**The process:**
1. **Check & apply** — we confirm eligibility with the Weslaco EDC and prepare most of the application and quote for you.
2. **Approval** — reviewed and approved at the Weslaco EDC (typically about two weeks).
3. **The 1-hour on-site visit** — interview and photos, all in one session.
4. **Build & launch** — we build it, you review, we apply your round of edits, connect Google, and launch — well inside the grant's 90-day window.

**Who typically qualifies:** a for-profit business with a physical storefront in Weslaco city limits or ETJ, 20 or fewer employees, an active Google Business Profile, in good standing with the City and the State of Texas, and no Weslaco marketing grant in the past 5 years. (A few categories are not eligible — e.g., attorneys, medical practices, daycares, insurance agents, franchises, big-box, non-profits, and home-based businesses. A quick check confirms eligibility.)

**Hosting & care after launch:** Care Basic — $15/month (hosting, no edits); Care Plus — $30/month (hosting + one content edit per month); additional edits $35 each.

**Outside Weslaco or not grant-eligible?** Direct-pay website options are available — contact us for a quote. Add-ons such as extra pages, a full Spanish-language version, or e-commerce are quoted separately.

**Weslaco program contact:** Daniel Rivera — call or text (956) 605-4321, or email daniel@triggers.media. Apply at https://weslaco.triggers.media.

## Services (full agency)

Triggers Media offers a full slate of digital marketing and creative services, tailored to each business's history, goals, and budget.

### Digital Marketing & Advertising
Full-scale campaigns from discovery to distribution: market research & analysis, brand strategy, content marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), local SEO, pay-per-click (PPC), social media marketing, email marketing, influencer & affiliate marketing, video marketing, mobile marketing, website design & development, conversion rate optimization (CRO), marketing automation, online reputation management, retargeting & remarketing, e-commerce marketing, CRM integration, and analytics & reporting.

### Digital Strategy & Consulting
Digital marketing audits, competitive analysis, digital & content strategy, SEO/PPC/social/email strategy, brand positioning & messaging, customer-journey mapping, marketing-funnel development, performance monitoring, marketing-automation strategy, e-commerce strategy, and crisis-management & response strategy.

### Website Design & Development
Custom websites, e-commerce builds, CMS and WordPress development, responsive design, front-end / back-end / full-stack development, web applications, API integration, redesigns & revamps, UX and UI design, mobile web, performance optimization, SEO-friendly development, security & compliance, database design, and ongoing maintenance & support.

### Social Media Management
Strategy development, content creation & curation, account setup & optimization, calendar planning, community management, paid social campaigns, influencer collaboration & outreach, analytics & reporting, social listening, reputation management, hashtag research, contests & giveaways, user-generated-content management, and platform-specific strategy for Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

### Paid Ads Management
PPC, Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, paid social (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok), display, video (YouTube), native, programmatic, and shopping ads (Google Shopping, Amazon); audience targeting & segmentation, A/B testing & optimization, conversion tracking, budget & bid strategy, local/geo-targeted advertising, competitor benchmarking, and campaign reporting.

### Media Production & Creative Services
Story-driven video and creative that highlights your strengths and helps audiences emotionally connect with your brand — event production, "About Us" / brand videos, and social-media content production.

### Photography
Product, lifestyle, corporate headshots, event, real estate, food, architectural, aerial & drone, e-commerce, editorial, portrait, commercial, and social-media content photography.

### Graphic Design
Logo design, social-media assets, business cards, flyers & brochures, push cards, and creative copywriting.

### Business Strategy & Consulting
Strategic planning (long-term vision & mission, goals, and roadmaps), market research & analysis, and business-process optimization.

**Does Triggers Media only serve Weslaco?**
No. Triggers Media is a full-service agency serving the entire Rio Grande Valley and beyond. The Weslaco grant program is one specific offering.

**What services does Triggers Media offer?**
Digital marketing & advertising, website design & development, video & photography, social media management, creative copywriting, paid digital advertising, and business strategy & consulting.

**Does Triggers Media offer a free consultation?**
Yes. Contact the team to schedule one.

**How do I get started?**

**What does "Your Partners in Growth" mean?**
It's Triggers Media's promise to be a collaborative partner — not just a vendor — working hand-in-hand with businesses to achieve sustained growth through strategic marketing.
